name: Kubeara Self-Hosted PaaS
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted control plane for deploying apps, databases and AI services on your own servers; official README states no software feature, seat or time limits, with 200+ deployment templates.
watch_out: Does not provide free VPS, compute, GPUs, storage, domains or AI inference; you supply and secure your own servers and Docker infrastructure. Kubeara Cloud is a distinct hosted control-plane offer with a separate one-server free tier; do not confuse it with this self-hosted edition. Enterprise SSO, LDAP, SLA and priority support are separate.
